arguments.command:
cd /app && python3 - << 'PY'
p='submission/ipv6_replay.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("import json\nimport os","import json\nimport math\nimport os")
old='''    try:
        return json.loads(text, object_pairs_hook=unique_object,
                          parse_constant=reject_constant)
    except InvalidInput:
        raise
    except (ValueError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        raise InvalidInput("invalid json") from exc
'''
new='''    try:
        obj = json.loads(text, object_pairs_hook=unique_object,
                         parse_constant=reject_constant)
    except InvalidInput:
        raise
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise InvalidInput("invalid json") from exc
    check_finite(obj)
    return obj


def check_finite(obj):
    stack = [obj]
    while stack:
        cur = stack.pop()
        if isinstance(cur, float):
            if not math.isfinite(cur):
                raise InvalidInput("nonfinite JSON number")
        elif isinstance(cur, dict):
            stack.extend(cur.values())
        elif isinstance(cur, list):
            stack.extend(cur)
'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
print('ok')
